kpis.description_fr: Revenu net d'intérêts. Pilote performance banque retail UK, sensible aux taux BoE et marges hypothécaires UK.
kpis.description_en: Net interest income. UK retail bank performance driver, sensitive to BoE rates and UK mortgage margins.

kpis.description_fr: Marge nette d'intérêts exprimée en taux sur actifs porteurs. Repli normalisation post-pic 2023, structural hedge compense partiellement.
kpis.description_en: Net interest margin expressed as rate on earning assets. Normalisation pullback post-2023 peak, structural hedge partially offsets.

kpis.description_fr: Ratio Common Equity Tier 1. Cible managériale 13-14% post-normalisation, marge confortable au-dessus exigences PRA UK.
kpis.description_en: Common Equity Tier 1 ratio. Management target 13-14% post-normalisation, comfortable buffer above UK PRA requirements.

kpis.description_fr: Prêts nets à la clientèle. Hypothécaires UK pilier dominant via marque NatWest et Royal Bank of Scotland, croissance retail prudente.
kpis.description_en: Net loans to customers. UK mortgages dominant pillar via NatWest and Royal Bank of Scotland brands, prudent retail growth.

kpis.description_fr: Dépôts clientèle. Base de financement core, stabilisation post-effet pandémie, ratio prêts/dépôts confortable autour 86%.
kpis.description_en: Customer deposits. Core funding base, stabilisation post pandemic effect, comfortable loans/deposits ratio around 86%.

kpis.description_fr: Rendement fonds propres tangibles (RoTE). KPI guidance NatWest, cible >15% mid-term, performance dans le top peer UK.
kpis.description_en: Return on tangible equity. NatWest guidance KPI, target >15% mid-term, top UK peer performance.

kpis.description_fr: Ratio coûts opérationnels sur revenu. Amélioration tendancielle via simplification et digitalisation, levier d'efficience opérationnelle.
kpis.description_en: Operating costs to income ratio. Trend improvement via simplification and digitalisation, operational efficiency lever.
